The replacement words are already documented in the actual 1998 Glossary, PDF page 47: [[File:ANH-D-Death-Star-Tractor-Beam-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p47-entry.png|frameless|300px]]. They also match both later full PC faces. Identical words alone do not prove identical external rules across editions.
|notes=* Original title, uniqueness, destiny 3, literal lore, category icon and A New Hope icon remain uncovered above the replacement Device band. These are inherited from the actual original face, not from a later PC full image.
* This is a Device, not a Character; no Character landspeed, Force sensitivity or formal characteristic is assigned. The 1998 Glossary, PDF page 131, and final Decipher Glossary Supplement (cover updated January 29, 2002), PDF page 11, already discuss tractor-beam capture. See current Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF pages 162–163. These source editions are kept distinct; no new gameplay change or engine defect is inferred from comparing their texts.
